settings.editorHint: Command used to open a file clicked in Source Control. Arguments are split on spaces and the file path is appended. Leave blank to use ZK_EDITOR, or cursor -g by default.
settings.accountUsage: Show account usage in the footer

footerThresholds.hint: Value at or above which a footer cell takes each color. Uncheck a color to hide it — the reading then falls through to the next lower enabled color.

settings.hooksIntegrationHint: Registers zashiki's hooks and statusLine in ~/.claude/settings.json so notifications, instant refresh, and the usage footer work.
settings.hooksConflictHint: You already have a statusLine — enabling wraps it so it keeps rendering alongside zashiki.

account.refreshTooltip: Switching accounts? Refresh to apply it to all sessions.
account.confirmBody: {{count}} running session(s) will be restarted to apply the switched account. Their conversations are kept.

accountUsage.title: Show Claude Code account usage
accountUsage.body: Relay Claude Code's 5-hour and weekly account usage to the footer. zashiki wires it up per launch without editing your ~/.claude settings.
accountUsage.subscriptionNote: Usage appears only for Claude.ai Pro/Max sessions, after the first response.
accountUsage.resumeNote: {{count}} running cockpit terminal(s) will show usage only after you resume them.

usageWarning.title: Approaching the usage limit
usageWarning.body: You will be locked out in {{percent}}%. Keep an eye on your usage.

firstRun.title: Set up Claude Code integration
firstRun.body: Register zashiki's hooks and statusLine in ~/.claude/settings.json to enable push notifications, instant state refresh, and the account-usage footer. It is idempotent and preserves your existing settings.
firstRun.preserveNote: Only zashiki's entries are added; you can remove them anytime from Settings.
firstRun.statusLineConflict: Your existing statusLine will be preserved (wrapped so it still renders).

addOrg.title: Add org
addOrg.hint: Enter the absolute path of a directory. Its final name becomes the org.
